description: Permanently delete a pump.fun alert rule by id from the authenticated three.ws account. DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible: the rule plus its cooldown tracker and per-channel delivery log are removed (cascade). The rule stops firing immediately. Deleting an already-deleted id returns not_found (so this is not idempotent). To pause a rule without losing it, prefer update_alert_rule with enabled:false. Returns the deleted rule id. Requires THREE_WS_SESSION.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule to delete (from list_alert_rules). This cannot be undone.

name: delete_alert_rule
title: Delete a pump.fun alert rule
